verdict.rationale: Unleash documents variants for A/B testing and "impact metrics" that query your own Prometheus or VictoriaMetrics instance. However, the evidence frames those metrics as release safeguards, used to progress or pause rollouts on error-rate and latency thresholds. Nothing shows defining experiment metrics from warehouse tables or ingested events, or analysing variant results against them, so this is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can define experiment metrics from my own data — warehouse tables or ingested events — instead of a black-box metric store
